info.title: ScreenshotAPI
info.summary: Website screenshots, HTML screenshots, and PDFs via API.
info.description: ScreenshotAPI captures public or authorized web pages as PNG, JPEG, WebP, or PDF. Use it when an application or AI agent needs hosted screenshot infrastructure without running browsers.

tags.name: Screenshots
tags.description: Capture URLs or HTML as images or PDFs.

get.summary: Capture a URL screenshot or PDF
get.description: Capture a public or authorized URL as PNG, JPEG, WebP, or PDF. This endpoint returns binary image/PDF data directly.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Absolute http or https URL to capture. Public or authorized URLs only.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Viewport width in pixels. Maximum 1920.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Viewport height in pixels. Maximum 10000.

parameters.name: fullPage
parameters.description: Capture the full scrollable page.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Output format.

parameters.name: quality
parameters.description: JPEG/WebP quality from 1 to 100.

parameters.name: colorScheme
parameters.description: Force light or dark color-scheme rendering.

parameters.name: waitUntil
parameters.description: Navigation lifecycle event to wait for before capture.

parameters.name: waitForSelector
parameters.description: CSS selector to wait for before capture.

parameters.name: delay
parameters.description: Additional delay in milliseconds after the page loads.

parameters.name: blockAds
parameters.description: Block common ad and tracker requests during capture.

parameters.name: removeCookieBanners
parameters.description: Hide and accept common cookie banners before capture.

parameters.name: cssInject
parameters.description: CSS to inject before capture. Maximum 10000 characters.

parameters.name: jsInject
parameters.description: JavaScript to evaluate before capture. Maximum 10000 characters.

parameters.name: stealthMode
parameters.description: Use stealth rendering for authorized targets.

parameters.name: devicePixelRatio
parameters.description: Retina/HiDPI capture scale.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: IANA timezone to emulate, such as America/New_York.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: BCP 47 locale to emulate, such as en-US.

parameters.name: cacheTtl
parameters.description: Response cache TTL in seconds. Maximum 604800.

parameters.name: preloadFonts
parameters.description: Preload discovered Google Fonts before capture.

parameters.name: removeElements
parameters.description: Comma-separated CSS selectors to remove before capture.

parameters.name: removePopups
parameters.description: Remove common popups, modals, and overlays.

parameters.name: mockupDevice
parameters.description: Wrap the screenshot in a device frame.

parameters.name: geoLatitude
parameters.description: Latitude for browser geolocation override.

parameters.name: geoLongitude
parameters.description: Longitude for browser geolocation override.

parameters.name: geoAccuracy
parameters.description: Geolocation accuracy in meters.

x-credits-remaining.description: Remaining monthly quota plus credit balance.

x-screenshot-id.description: Unique identifier for this screenshot request.

x-cache.description: Whether the response was served from cache.

post.description: Capture raw HTML or a URL as PNG, JPEG, WebP, or PDF. Use POST when sending HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or larger structured options.

x-credits-remaining.description: Remaining monthly quota plus credit balance.

x-screenshot-id.description: Unique identifier for this screenshot request.

x-cache.description: Whether the response was served from cache.

get.description: Returns API health status and server timestamp.

BearerAuth.description: Alternative API key transport using Authorization: Bearer.

url.description: Absolute http or https URL to capture.

html.description: Raw HTML to render before capture.

quotaResetsAt.description: When the plan’s included allowance resets. Present on 402 responses; null when the account holds no entitled plan.
